content: The sun does not forget a village simply because it is small and hidden in the hills.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: Grand capitals, roaring metropolises, and famous celebrities believe they hold a monopoly on the attention of heaven. But the morning sun beams its golden warmth with the exact same tender love onto a thatched hut in the most remote valley. You are seen and known.
practicalInsight: If your life feels obscure, unheralded, or overlooked today, breathe deeply. The universe warms you with complete love.
reflectionPrompt: Why do you measure your significance by worldly fame when the cosmos shines on you without reservation?
